title: dianthus subacaulis subsp. brachyanthus
intro: Dianthus subacaulis subsp. brachyanthus, commonly known as Alpine Pink, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus subacaulis subsp. brachyanthus include its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate anxiety, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
